0x000877.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008A9.en: 「With my current skills...@　this is my limit...!」

0x00091A.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009A2.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A1C.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000BCC.en: 「Tch!　So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000C07.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C5B.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000CCF.en: 「Ngh!　No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D45.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DAC.en: 「This is it for me... The rest is up to you.」

0x000DDE.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is as far as I go!」

0x000E1A.en: 「Nngh!　They got the drop on me...」

0x000E58.en: 「No good, I've taken too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000EA5.en: 「What a bind. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EE3.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F2A.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FD5.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one to fall like a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0011C5.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011FA.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012E6.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x001334.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013EF.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00141E.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00145C.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00148B.en: 「I can go no further. Please excuse me.」

0x001516.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00167C.en: 「I'm bailing out...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x00173A.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019CE.en: 「...After Baral's barrier went up, we followed the Joint Staff's orders@ and headed for Grand Christmas, where we engaged the Gaia Sabers...」

0x001A8B.en: 「We defeated Alteur Steinbeck@ and every one of the Sabers.」

0x001AEA.en: 「I see... So they prioritized seizing our forces@ over hunting down the outside enemy.」

0x001B61.en: 「Yes... We couldn't accept that, so we tried to detain Alteur@ and expose his schemes, but...」

0x001C03.en: 「In the end, his true intentions remain unknown...」

0x001C6F.en: 「We joined the Operation Reconquista combined space fleet@ and took on the Guests.」

0x001CEC.en: 「And during the opening battle, the Heaven's Gate recapture op,@ Mekibos appeared.」

0x001D51.en: 「Mekibos...!? The one from the <Inspectors>...?@ He was alive?」

0x001DC4.en: 「Yes.@ He was sent to the Earth Sphere as a special envoy@ of Zovorc's Privy Council.」

0x001E3C.en: 「Zovorc... So that's the formal name of their homeland?」

0x001E88.en: 「Correct. Zovorc has two major factions, Volga and Zogal...@ The former corresponds to the Inspectors,@ the latter to the Guests.」

0x001F4B.en: 「Mekibos brought Zezernan the Privy Council's recall order,@ hoping to pull him out and end the Earth-Guest war,@ but...」

0x002014.en: 「Zezernan refused.@ Left with no choice, we faced him in a final battle@ at the Moon Cradle... and won.」

0x0020AD.en: 「Mekibos then asked to accompany our unit, and I allowed it.@ We're holding him in our custody, so to speak,@ until this conflict is over.」

0x00219E.en: 「To investigate our situation firsthand, he says.@ In return, he'll join the fighting as well.」

0x00223A.en: 「From watching his actions, I've judged that we can.」

0x002299.en: 「Dr. Shu Shirakawa has also offered@ his cooperation and is traveling with us.」

0x00231D.en: 「Yes... Thanks to Dr. Shirakawa's proposal,@ we were able to return to Earth.」

0x0023C8.en: 「Simply put, we slid down the boundary between@ Baral's barrier and Ruina's field, with the@ Hyperion and Granzon guiding the way.」

0x00248E.en: 「So you didn't break through Baral's barrier, then...」

0x0024DD.en: 「No.@ Put another way, without Ruina's field,@ we could never have returned to Earth.」

0x002558.en: 「And after we descended to Antarctica,@ we were surrounded by Ruina, but...」

0x0025C3.en: 「The Custos saved us from that crisis.」

0x00260F.en: 「! Why would they do such a thing...!?」

0x00264C.en: 「Baral seems intent on fighting Ruina...@ I suspect they lent their strength to us@ since we share the same enemy.」

0x0026F7.en: 「To make us defeat Ruina...@ No, to buy time until the Grand Nirvana Project@ can be activated...?」

0x0027AC.en: 「...The Joint Staff prioritized Ruina over Baral@ and ordered Operation Icebreaker...@ that's why we came to Antarctica too...」

0x00288A.en: 「I understand.@ Let's settle things with Ruina here.」

0x0028E3.en: 「...And so, I'm counting on you,@ everyone aboard the Hagane.」

0x002942.en: (Wow... that outfit's like 120% sex appeal...@ I could never wear something like that...)

0x0029B6.en: 「Everyone, forgive me for interrupting your meal.@ I'm a poor hand at this, but I hope to be@ in your care as well, I do.」

0x002A8A.en: 「Lt. Lamia's the one calling that out?」

0x002AB8.en: 「Anyway... eat up, eat up.@ The next stretch'll be a long one, so we'd@ better get some food in us while we can.」

0x002B3F.en: 「The meals on this ship are quite lavish.」

0x002B70.en: 「That's the secret to the Steel Dragon Squadron's strength.@ Friday's Steel Dragon Curry is superb,@ some talk of selling it commercially...」

0x002C2D.en: 「Oh, that'd be great.@ I got the recipe, but I just can't@ get the taste to come out the same.」

0x002CF4.en: 「Presia, you get her to teach you how, too.」

0x002D44.en: 「...Josh... um... I'm sorry.@ Could I get something to wipe this up?」

0x002E3D.en: 「Josh, I'll take care of it...@ You look after Glacies.」

0x002F08.en: 「This oral energy source, how is it to be ingested?@ It seems rather too hard.」

0x002F82.en: 「Oh, that, you have to peel the shell first...」

0x003018.en: 「...She's still not used to@ meals like this, is she.」

0x003071.en: 「But being able to eat together@ with everyone now, you could call@ that progress, couldn't you?」

0x0030FB.en: 「True...@ She doesn't feel as unstable as before, at least...」

0x00314E.en: 「...How about Wen? Getting used to it?」

0x00317F.en: 「We never went to this much trouble@ just to refuel, but... it's not bad.@ I like this liquid.」

0x003258.en: 「That's the deadly Kusuha Juice, isn't it!?」

0x003289.en: 「...I asked Lt. Kusuha to make it for me.@ She said it was the super-mild@ version, though...」

0x003393.en: 「Yes... Unlike the rumors, it was delicious.」

0x0033EC.en: 「Someone oughta drink it and find out.」

0x003420.en: 「Then you do it, since you brought it up.」

0x0034B9.en: 「You said it! Fine, I'll drink it!」

0x003572.en: 「I figured you'd keel over for sure...」

0x0035A9.en: 「It's crazy bitter, but not enough to knock ya out.」

0x0035E3.en: 「Then it really is@ the super-mild version, huh...」

0x003639.en: 「B-but for Ing and Ventos to call that@　stuff delicious...」

0x0036A1.en: 「...Their taste buds are strange, no question.」

0x00371F.en: 「...Watching her like that, she's just like a child...」

0x00375F.en: 「Even though Presia looks so much younger.@ Is that some kind of role-play?」

0x003829.en: 「Stop that, Saphine.@ Don't go teaching Princess Shine weird things.」

0x00388B.en: 「...Yes, Glacies.@ I've finished wiping it up.」

0x003922.en: 「I don't know how she and I look to you...@ but I've only existed for a very short time since I was made.」

0x0039F0.en: 「The day you were born.@　Humans celebrate it every year when that day comes around.」

0x003A55.en: 「The day I was born... I don't know.」

0x003AB4.en: 「Well, I guess it depends on the person...」

0x003AE5.en: 「It's not that it's important, exactly.@　It just makes me happy that everyone celebrates.」

0x003B3B.en: 「If you don't know your birthday, why not just pick one?@　That's what Despinis did.」

0x003BB3.en: 「For me... the day Fiona and the others took me in@　became my birthday...」

0x003C1E.en: 「Then, Josh... let's make it that day.@　The day Ventos and Laki came to us.」

0x003CBA.en: 「Yeah, I know...@　But I think Chris would want that too...」

0x003D32.en: 「The launch time for Operation Icebreaker@　has been moved up. Two hours early...@　0800 today.」

0x003DFF.en: 「A large force of mobile weapons has appeared@　outside the Meriden Plum barrier.」

0x003E61.en: 「So they're all set to welcome us...」

0x003E9B.en: 「Are the Federation units moving on schedule?」

0x003EDC.en: 「Still... it's unsettling.@　They know our movements, yet they aren't@　launching a preemptive strike.」

0x003F97.en: 「They may be luring us in on purpose.」

0x003FFC.en: 「Using those who join Operation Icebreaker@　as fuel to awaken the King of Ruin...」

0x00409E.en: 「According to the Melior Esse, when the strong@　fall into despair, they give off waves@　of the highest quality.」

0x004131.en: 「So we're the perfect bait, then.@　And if even the Melior Esse become fuel,@　that's the worst of it.」

0x0041CD.en: 「So either way, there's a chance@　the King of Ruin awakens...」

0x00423E.en: 「Regardless... tell all units to be in position@　two hours before the operation begins.」

0x0042C5.en: （Operation Icebreaker...@　It's not only the ice we have to shatter...）

0x0043AE.en: 「Yeah... to a god I've never believed in.」

0x004453.en: 「Is there any point in praying to a phantom?」

0x00457B.en: 「Could this be... fear...@　Is this what it means to be afraid? But why...?」

0x004602.en: 「Am I... afraid? Of fighting Perfectio...@　and the one who created me...?」

0x004686.en: 「Afraid of dying in battle...@　of my existence being erased...」

0x0046DC.en: 「Afraid that if I vanish... I won't be able@　to live together with you... How foolish. I...」

0x004763.en: 「Laki... it's not a lie or a pretense.@　That's a real life, a real heart.」

0x0047BC.en: 「It's proof that you're truly alive,@　just like me.」

0x004846.en: 「I'm scared... I always am, when it comes to fighting. I said that before.@　Nobody wants to die. But still...@　we can't just not do it.」

0x0048F7.en: 「Humans are... strong.@　You can resist fear and still@　go into battle.」

0x004991.en: 「But... even if... I survive...@　there's no place for me in this world...」

0x004A5B.en: 「I'll... make one. A place for you...」

0x004AFC.en: (Dad... I'm coming back now, to Fabula Foresu,@ to put an end to everything you caused...)

0x004C08.en: 「Captain,@　we're about to reach the D5 line!」

0x004C5B.en: 「All right, this is it! Don't fall behind the Hiryu!」

0x004CAB.en: 「Twelve o'clock, range 6!@　Looks like the Ruina and Custos@　are fighting each other!」

0x004D64.en: 「Ngh, damn Baral...!@　We'll have to fall back into Meriden Plum for now.」

0x004DCC.en: 「Ruina survivors are retreating toward Meriden Plum!@　No movement from the Custos!」

0x004E71.en: 「The Custos and mobile weapon groups@　are pulling out of the combat zone!」

0x004EE3.en: 「Yeah. Either they can't get into Meriden Plum,@　or they don't intend to...」

0x004F54.en: 「Either way, Baral means to make us@　settle things with the Ruina.」

0x00502E.en: 「...If Baral is deliberately staying out of@　Meriden Plum, then 'a tiger at the front gate,@　a wolf at the back' doesn't quite cover it.」

0x0050E2.en: 「Even if Baral lies in wait afterward...@　we have to defeat the Ruina here.@　Once the King of Ruin revives, it'll be too late.」

0x0051AE.en: 「Our unit presses on as we are.」

0x0051D9.en: 「...From here, Glacies and I will be your@ pilot guide. We'll neutralize@ Meriden Plum.」

0x0052B0.en: 「Both engines, flank speed three!@　We're breaking through to Fabula Foresu!」

0x005315.en: 「Contagio,@　Studium and Fabularis have@　broken through Meriden Plum.」

0x0053C2.en: 「It seems Baral cannot enter Meriden Plum.」

0x005405.en: 「Whatever those fools do,@　the King of Ruin will soon awaken.@　With that, all begins and all ends.」

0x005498.en: 「We've finally come back. The war with the Ruina@　started right here...」

0x0054FD.en: 「The surface looks almost@　exactly as it did back then.」

0x005550.en: 「But there's no telling what's become@　of Fabula Foresu underground...」

0x0055AC.en: 「Sensors are next to useless.@　Waves like ES waves keep pouring out@　from beneath the ice, nonstop.」

0x00564E.en: 「So we've got no choice but to see with our own eyes@　what's happening down below.」

0x0056B3.en: 「Negative waves are converging...@　The King of Ruin's awakening is near.@　That much is certain.」

0x005731.en: 「Heh heh heh, humans, you've done well to come this far.」

0x005790.en: 「Soon, the King of Ruin will appear.」

0x0057C4.en: 「Tremble, heh heh heh.@　Every living thing on this planet will die, and with@　those waves, our King will lead all to ruin.」

0x005866.en: 「Shut up! We're still alive!@　And we've come to strike down your monstrous king!」

0x0058D4.en: 「That fighting spirit, too, feeds the King of Ruin.@　The moment you came here, you began@　hastening his awakening, heh heh heh.」

0x005976.en: 「Heh, I can't wait to see what comes crawling out.@ I want to see it soon.」

0x0059D5.en: 「No, if I had a choice, I'd rather not see it.」

0x005A06.en: 「The door to ruin is already opening.@ Only death beyond despair awaits you.@ Writhe, suffer, and meet your final agony.」

0x005AF6.en: 「I wonder if a reaction like that@　feeds the King of Ruin too?」

0x005B49.en: 「Who cares.@　More importantly, shut that woman up.」

0x005B97.en: 「Honestly, she's an embarrassment to us all.@　Can't read the room. Totally clueless.@　You'd think she could say something a bit sharper.」

0x005CB0.en: 「Carve it into your hearts with despair, fear, and hatred.@　My King, and my name.」

0x005D0C.en: 「If that king destroys everything,@　doesn't that include you too?」

0x005DA9.en: 「That's why we fight.@　This fighting, here and now, is the very@　meaning of being born into this world.」

0x005E2A.en: 「To fight you is the reason I exist.@　I was created by the King of Ruin,@　and by him I am given death, ruin.」

0x005ED5.en: 「That is my fate. I fight until that moment, then fade.@　It is my one and only reason to exist.」

0x005F61.en: 「Hmph... you've made your peace, in more ways than one.」

0x005F9B.en: 「Come, then.@　I will shatter your hope, the feelings@　and hearts that humans lean upon, to dust.」

0x006031.en: 「Aquila... can you shatter me too? I, who am not human.」

0x0060D0.en: 「Don't you see it? The fear within you.@　Don't think you can beat me like that.」

0x006138.en: 「Heh heh, I told you then: die and be useful.@ Better still if you feel fear.@ Become fuel for the King of Ruin, with the humans.」

0x0061F8.en: 「Yes, all who stand here shall writhe in despair,@　lament, and die in agony.」

0x006263.en: 「Aquila, it's no use.@　They gave me a new way to live, and they are strong.@　Words like those can't break their will.」

0x006311.en: 「Ventos, is it. I won't ask why.@　But it makes no difference if you join them.@　I'll crush you all together.」

0x0063A7.en: 「I won't lose.@　Now I understand the reason for their strength. The source of human strength.」

0x00640C.en: 「Interesting... then show it to me.@　The measure of humans defying the fate of ruin.」

0x006486.en: 「Once I see it, your role is over.@　You'll open the way for us.」

0x0064E5.en: 「And you will fall not to the King of Ruin,@　but to our blades.」

0x006553.en: 「The die is cast. Don't think you can stop it.」

0x00658D.en: 「First, become fuel for the King of Ruin.@　Then we'll strike down the king as well.」

0x006601.en: 「Aquila, Contagio...@　The gate my father opened, I'll close with my own hands.@　No matter what... yes, even at the cost of my life...!」

0x0066F0.en: 「I know. Keep Josh and the others'@　machines marked, all right?」

0x00674F.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units!@　Target is the Melior Esse! Begin the attack!」

0x0067B4.en: 「Get out of the way, Aquila!@　I have to get to Fabula Foresu!」

0x006825.en: 「You'll perish here, without ever seeing@　the King of Ruin's form.」

0x006881.en: 「Like hell I'll end this without learning the truth!」

0x0068C1.en: 「Soon it will all be over!@　Heh heh heh, hahaha!」

0x00690E.en: 「No, the only ones ending here are you!」

0x00694B.en: 「You seem different than before, human.@　Has the other one vanished?」

0x0069A4.en: 「I don't have to answer that for you!」

0x0069ED.en: 「So it's true. Then you'll vanish too.」

0x006A33.en: 「Heh heh heh, whatever synergy you and@　that machine create together,@　it no longer matters.」

0x006AC0.en: 「You too shall vanish, just like your other self.」

0x006B03.en: 「I won't lose!@　I'll fight for Chris's sake as well!」

0x006B50.en: 「Then I'll shatter those feelings!@　Heh heh heh, hahaha!」

0x006BB2.en: 「Broken though she is, for a Melior Esse@　to feel fear... or perhaps it's because she's broken.」

0x006C29.en: 「I'll defy the fear, and you as well.@ Just like Josh and Lim.」

0x006C8E.en: 「Heh heh heh, this I did not expect,@　a Melior Esse and a human trying to stand together.@　But where it all ends will not change.」

0x006D36.en: 「All things with form break, all living things must die.」

0x006D76.en: 「Josh will not accept that it be brought about@　by the King of Ruin.」

0x006DF0.en: 「And I do not wish for him to be erased...!」

0x006E39.en: 「Even if you lend humans your power,@　you cannot stop the King of Ruin's awakening.@　It's already too late.」

0x006EC3.en: 「Lim and the others don't believe that... and neither do I.@ There's still something I can do...」

0x006F3D.en: 「Heh heh heh, you were made to understand humans@　more deeply. There was always a chance@　they'd sway you.」

0x006FDC.en: 「Maybe it wasn't chance...@ that Lim and I came to understand each other@ through the Sympathia...」

0x007075.en: 「Who decided that? Who wished for it?@　Either way, everything will perish soon.@　Yes, the how and why no longer mean a thing.」

0x007117.en: 「Kh, heh heh heh!@　It seems... I'm the one to perish first...」

0x007179.en: 「But the result's the same...@　My erasure too becomes fuel for the King of Ruin...@　heh heh heh.」

0x0071F7.en: 「You've hastened the hour of ruin@　with your own hands, hahaha!」

0x007256.en: 「It can't be stopped! It can't be resisted!@　My ruin will draw out your despair!@　Haaaaaah!!」

0x0072E9.en: 「...I didn't come here to despair.@　Yeah, as if anyone here would ever despair.」

0x007363.en: 「So you defeated Contagio.@　Yes, that's the power I wanted to see.」

0x007411.en: 「Little time remains to you!@　Fight me with all your strength!」

0x0074BD.en: 「If you claim to defy the power of ruin@　even beyond the limits of humans, of living things...@　if you claim you can stop it...」

0x007562.en: 「Go on, try it, then...@　how far can you defy the fate laid out for you...!」

0x007614.en: 「Right now, I feel that I'm truly alive!@　This is what I...!!」

0x007682.en: (...So this is what it means to live as a Melior Esse...)

0x0076C8.en: 「Heh heh... Aquila...@　You died to feed the King of Ruin. So be it.」

0x007736.en: 「You're next, damn you, Contagio! @ Get ready to die!」

0x007789.en: 「I told you, the result is the same.@　Yes, even if Aquila falls. Heh heh heh.」

0x00781F.en: 「Kh, heh heh heh...@　Our destruction, too, shall feed the King of Ruin...@　Heh heh heh heh.」

0x00789A.en: 「Enemy units in the surface zone, signals gone!」

0x0078D4.en: 「...Doesn't look like any new enemies@　will come up from underground.」

0x007940.en: 「A huge crack in the ice!!@　The ice is collapsing!!」

0x0079BB.en: 「Yes! Judging by how the cracks are spreading,@　a massive one!」

0x007A11.en: 「Eun, relay to all units!@　Push on down beneath the ice!」

0x007A75.en: (Dad... I'm coming now.@ To Fabula Foresu...!)
